description: LivingStoneSolution Technologies is led by a Washington D.C.-anchored team with members in Chicago and New York. The company is a Certified Business Enterprise (CBE) of the District of Columbia, serving federal, commercial, and DMV-area clients through four specialized divisions. Based in Washington, D.C. and working worldwide, we have partnered with businesses from all over the world, across different continents and countries.
globalTeam: Based in Washington, D.C. Working Worldwide: LivingStoneSolution Technologies operates from Washington, D.C., with team members in Chicago, IL and New York, NY. The team serves federal, commercial, and DMV-area clients, and has worked with businesses from all over the world across different continents and countries, spanning software development, mobile applications, generative engine optimization (GEO), and brand strategy.
